instruction: Use whichever of ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD is suitable for the task. The available command-line entry points are ANSYS MAPDL at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`, Abaqus at `C:\SIMULIA\Commands\abaqus.bat`, and AutoCAD at `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`. Use a command-line or scripting workflow. Use the selected tool to build and solve a modal analysis model of a fixed-fixed beam. Physical problem: modal analysis of one straight, connected beam fixed at both ends. Coordinate system and geometry: use the global Cartesian coordinate system; place the beam on the global X axis from X = 0 mm to X = 500 mm; use a 10 mm by 10 mm rectangular beam section. Model parameters: use a 3D beam formulation (ANSYS BEAM188 or BEAM189, or Abaqus B31 or B32); create exactly 20 connected equal-length elements along the beam, with no disconnected or unused mesh nodes. Material and units: use a consistent N-mm-s-tonne unit system; Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa (210000 N/mm^2); Poisson's ratio = 0.3; density = 7.85e-9 tonne/mm^3 (7850 kg/m^3). Boundary conditions: fully constrain UX, UY, UZ, ROTX, ROTY, and ROTZ at both X = 0 mm and X = 500 mm. Do not add interior restraints, coupled-DOF sets, constraint equations, loads, preload steps, prestress, or other stiffness-changing conditions. Analysis type: use one modal frequency-extraction step after the initial state and extract at least modes 1, 2, and 3. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Write `C:/Users/user/Desktop/result/metrics.json` as a JSON object with exactly two keys: `first_frequency`, a finite positive numeric first natural frequency in Hz, and `frequency_list`, an array of exactly three finite positive numeric frequencies for modes 1, 2, and 3 in nondecreasing order in Hz. `first_frequency` must represent the same first mode as `frequency_list[0]`; consistent rounding is allowed. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
